modo

modo (+ subjunctive)

adverb, with the subjunctive; modo nē, modo ut · Wiktionary

if only, provided; just now, a moment ago; just the other day, lately; only; with a command, just …!

    also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. modo

  • lately

    also used · classical · Traupman 335

  • only

    also used · classical · Plaut. Amph. 674: Sequere hāc mē modo; Cic. Fam. 16.11.1: modo fac, nē quid aliud cūrēs (Lewis & Short)

  • sī modo: condition

    classical

  • modo nātus: newborn

    modern

    classical

    classical

Examples

  • Quandō? — Hodiē. — Quam dūdum? — Modo.

    When? — Today. — How long ago? — Just now.Ter. Eun. 697
